name: zvideo_dd_create_fullscreen_surfaces_for_renderer
description: zVideo_dd::CreateFullscreenSurfacesForRenderer selects the half-resolution, fullscreen hardware, or fullscreen software surface creation path from the renderer globals.
known_limits: VC5SP3 target zvideo_dd_create_fullscreen_surfaces_for_renderer matches 0x4a88f0 with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking; tier S is accepted for this selector leaf.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a88f0 validates testing g_zVideo_UseHalfResBackbuffer first, tailcalling zVideo_dd::CreateHalfResBackbufferSurfaces when nonzero, otherwise comparing g_zVideo_RendererType to hardware renderer value 1, tailcalling zVideo_dd::CreateFullscreenHardwareSurfaces for hardware, and tailcalling zVideo_dd::CreateFullscreenSoftwareSurfaces otherwise.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a88f0 has no warnings and matches the implemented selector logic and return propagation.

The native smoke patches the three branch callees with distinct return values, verifies half-resolution selection takes priority over renderer type, verifies renderer type 1 selects the hardware branch, and verifies other renderer values select the software branch.
